sentences.en: You know, it had to be Hellman's mayonnaise.

sentences.en: New York's nursing homes is now the subject of a political firestorm and a federal investigation.
sentences.zh: 现在正成为一场政治风暴和联邦调查的主题。

sentences.en: Today, we begin a two-part look with my colleague, Amy Julia Harris, at how the state's nursing homes became epicenters of death during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将与我的同事艾米·朱莉娅·哈里斯一起，分两部分探讨该州的养老院是如何在疫情期间成为死亡震中的。

sentences.en: Well, Lori, can we maybe go back to that time?
sentences.zh: 那么，劳里，我们能回到那个时候吗？

sentences.en: And you tell me the story from the beginning of, you know, how your mom, she was first in the hospital and then went to the nursing home.
sentences.zh: 你从头开始告诉我，你妈妈是怎么先住进医院，然后又去了养老院的。

sentences.zh: 她说她妈妈讨厌孤独。

sentences.zh: 劳里的父亲去世后，劳里就一直照顾她。

sentences.zh: 她最后交了很多朋友。

sentences.en: And she would give me a list every day of what everybody wanted.
sentences.zh: 她每天都会给我列一张清单，写着大家想要什么。

sentences.en: And I either had to pick it up or make it and bring it in for them.

sentences.en: And they would sit around and eat their cheese and crackle platters and everything.

sentences.en: And Lori visited her mother nearly every day.
sentences.zh: 劳里几乎每天都去探望她的母亲。

sentences.zh: 她说，虽然她妈妈当时状况还不错，而且很期待回家，医生也说可能几周后就能出院。

sentences.en: But then, in mid-March, the pandemic slammed New York.
sentences.zh: 但到了三月中旬，疫情重创了纽约。

sentences.en: And Governor Andrew Cuomo, knowing the risk that the virus posed to older residents, announced a lockdown of nursing homes, saying only medically necessary visits would be allowed.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁·科莫州长意识到病毒对老年居民构成的风险，宣布对养老院实施封锁，称只允许医疗必需的探视。

sentences.en: And then she's going to be at home with people coming in and out of the house.
sentences.zh: 然后她回家的话，会有各种人进进出出。

sentences.en: So they were saying because it was a lockdown facility, that would be safer than if she was at home where you're coming and going?
sentences.zh: 所以他们是说因为那是封锁设施，比她在家时有人进进出出更安全？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So we thought, okay, so they'll be on lockdown.
sentences.zh: 所以我们想，好吧，既然他们会封锁。

sentences.en: Everything will be okay.

sentences.en: Right.

sentences.en: So Lori agrees to let her mom stay at the nursing home.

sentences.zh: 在通话中，她妈妈描述了养老院内部的生活是如何开始改变的。

sentences.en: You know, there's a lot of running around and it's just different than it was.
sentences.zh: 你知道，到处都在跑来跑去，和以前不一样了。

sentences.en: And they're so short-staffed and blah, blah, blah.

sentences.en: So I was thinking, well, maybe they're sending people to different floors.

sentences.en: Maybe they're going to training in case they get COVID.

sentences.zh: 她摔倒了两次。

sentences.en: Is it fine in the fall?
sentences.zh: 摔倒了没事吗？

sentences.en: Did she hit her head?
sentences.zh: 她撞到头了吗？

sentences.en: Did she have a stroke?
sentences.zh: 她中风了吗？

sentences.en: What's going on with my mother?
sentences.zh: 我母亲到底怎么了？

sentences.en: So he said, no, I think it's a UTI.
sentences.zh: 他说，不，我觉得是尿路感染。

sentences.en: He said, we did the test and we have to wait for the results to come back.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们做了检查，必须等结果出来。

sentences.en: He said, and it could also be COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 他说，也可能是新冠肺炎。

sentences.en: The doctor tells her, your mother might have a urinary tract infection or she might have COVID-19,
sentences.zh: 医生告诉她，你母亲可能患有尿路感染，也可能感染了新冠肺炎，

sentences.en: which Lori says is how she first found out that COVID had been found in the facility.
sentences.zh: 洛丽说，她就是这样第一次得知疗养院里出现了新冠病例。

sentences.en: And I'm sitting on the back of my cousin and I have him on speakerphone.
sentences.zh: 我当时正坐在我表亲的后座上，开着免提和他通话。

sentences.en: And me and my cousin just looked at me.
sentences.zh: 我和我表亲面面相觑。

sentences.en: So like, you got to be, I said, wait a minute.
sentences.zh: 我说，你得……等等。

sentences.en: When we can get through, we ask every time, is COVID in that facility?
sentences.zh: 每次我们能打通电话时，我们都会问，疗养院里有新冠病例吗？

sentences.en: And we are told no every time.
sentences.zh: 而每次得到的回答都是没有。

sentences.en: And you're telling me that you had to call and tell me that my mother fell out of her wheelchair.
sentences.zh: 现在你却打电话告诉我，我母亲从轮椅上摔下来了。

sentences.en: You had to call and tell me that my mother fell out of her bed.
sentences.zh: 你打电话告诉我，我母亲从床上摔下来了。

sentences.en: But you didn't have to call and tell me that COVID was in the facility?
sentences.zh: 但你却没打电话告诉我疗养院里有新冠病例？

sentences.en: Are you freaking kidding me?
sentences.zh: 你在跟我开玩笑吗？

sentences.en: So then I said, okay, so you're testing her for the UTI.
sentences.zh: 于是我说，好吧，你们在给她做尿路感染检查。

sentences.en: I said, and you're testing her for COVID?
sentences.zh: 我说，你们在给她做新冠检测吗？

sentences.en: So he said, no.
sentences.zh: 他说，没有。

sentences.en: I said, why not?
sentences.zh: 我说，为什么不？

sentences.en: He said, she doesn't meet the requirements.
sentences.zh: 他说，她不符合检测条件。

sentences.en: I said, which is?
sentences.zh: 我说，条件是什么？

sentences.en: He said, a fever.
sentences.zh: 他说，发烧。

sentences.en: Your mother doesn't have a fever.
sentences.zh: 你母亲没有发烧。

sentences.en: I said, my mother is sick.
sentences.zh: 我说，我母亲病了。

sentences.en: I talked to her on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我周日还和她通过话。

sentences.en: You're telling me that now there's a chance she might have COVID because it's in the building and you're not testing her?
sentences.zh: 你现在告诉我，她有可能感染了新冠，因为楼里有病例，而你们却不给她做检测？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I reached out to the nursing home with a detailed list of questions about Lorraine's treatment,
sentences.zh: 我联系了疗养院，列出了一份关于洛林治疗情况的详细问题清单，

sentences.en: but the home declined to comment, citing privacy concerns, and they defended the overall quality of care.
sentences.zh: 但疗养院以隐私为由拒绝置评，并为他们的整体护理质量进行了辩护。

sentences.en: But Lori's description of the doctor's response tracks with how a lot of nursing homes in New
sentences.zh: 但洛丽对医生反应的描述，与纽约许多疗养院在疫情期间的处理方式相吻合。

sentences.en: York said they handled this moment in the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 当时新冠检测试剂非常紧缺，即使在疗养院也是如此。

sentences.en: COVID tests were really hard to come by, even in nursing homes.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果病人不符合检测条件，比如没有发烧，疗养院说他们仍会按照病人可能感染了新冠来处理。

sentences.en: And so if a patient didn't meet the qualifications to receive a test, like running a fever, the facility said they still tried to operate as if the patient might have it.
sentences.zh: 我已经几周没见到我母亲了，而且我母亲病得很重。

sentences.en: I haven't seen my mother in weeks, and my mother is sick.
sentences.zh: 我想知道我母亲是否感染了新冠。

sentences.en: I want to know if my mother has COVID.
sentences.zh: 我说，而且……

sentences.en: I said, and...
sentences.zh: 洛丽说，她对与医生的谈话并不放心。

sentences.en: Lori says she was not reassured by her conversation with the doctor.
sentences.zh: 她告诉医生，她想把母亲接出疗养院。

sentences.en: She told him she'd like to take her mother out of the facility.
sentences.zh: 他的回答基本上是，我不能让你这么做。

sentences.en: His response was essentially, I can't let you do that.
sentences.zh: 他说，你不能把你母亲带回家。

sentences.en: He said, you're not taking your mother home.
sentences.zh: 我说，我要把我母亲带回家。

sentences.en: I said, I am taking my mother home.
sentences.zh: 他说，嗯，你知道的，我们没打算安排出院。

sentences.en: So he said, well, you know, we're not planning a relief.
sentences.zh: 我说，我母亲要回家了。

sentences.en: I said, my mother's coming home.
sentences.zh: 所以他坚持说他们没有准备相关文书。

sentences.en: So he left it as they were not planning the paperwork.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，她与一名夜班护士通了话，询问疗养院是什么时候首次发现新冠病例的。

sentences.en: A few hours later, she spoke with a night nurse, and she asked him when COVID had first been discovered at the facility.
sentences.zh: 他说是在三月份。

sentences.en: And he said it was in March.
sentences.zh: 我说是在封锁前还是封锁后？

sentences.en: I said it was in March before the lockdown or after lockdown.
sentences.zh: 他说是在封锁后。

sentences.en: He said after lockdown.
sentences.zh: 他说第一例新冠病例是从好撒玛利亚医院转来的。

sentences.en: And he said the first case of COVID was a transfer from Good Samaritan.
sentences.zh: 也就是我母亲最初住的那家隔壁医院。

sentences.en: Which is the hospital next door where my mother started out.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，在库莫州长下令封锁疗养院不到两周后，他的政府为了腾出医院床位，下令疗养院必须接收医院转出的新冠阳性患者。

sentences.en: It turned out that less than two weeks after Governor Cuomo issued the lockdown of nursing homes, his administration, scrambling to free up beds in hospitals, ordered that nursing
sentences.zh: 尽管一些疗养院本身表示反对，认为他们没有准备好处理这些病人。

sentences.en: homes must accept COVID-positive patients from the hospitals.
sentences.zh: 在洛丽被告知“圣母慰藉”疗养院是她母亲最安全的地方，除了工作人员外没有人进出之后，

sentences.en: This was despite objections from some of the nursing homes themselves, which felt unprepared to handle these patients.
sentences.zh: 夜班护士现在却告诉她，一名新冠患者已经被转入了疗养院。

sentences.en: And so after Lori had been reassured that Our Lady of Consolation would be the safest place
sentences.zh: 最终，我们不可能确切知道新冠病毒是如何进入疗养院的。

sentences.en: for her mother, with no one other than staff members coming or going, the night nurse was now telling her that a patient with COVID had been transferred into the nursing home.
sentences.zh: 但在这一点上，洛丽下定了决心。

sentences.en: It's ultimately impossible to know exactly how COVID entered the facility.
sentences.zh: 那是4月7日。

sentences.en: But at this point, Lori makes up her mind.
sentences.zh: 我去了疗养院。

sentences.en: So that was April 7th.
sentences.zh: 你亲自去了那里？

sentences.en: I went to the nursing home.
sentences.zh: 我亲自去了那里。

sentences.en: You physically went there?
sentences.zh: 尽管一切都处于封锁状态？

sentences.en: I physically went there.
sentences.zh: 确实封锁了。

sentences.en: And even though everything is locked down?
sentences.zh: 我说，我要见我母亲。

sentences.en: It was locked down.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: And I said, I want to see my mother.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间去探索付费墙后的内容，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 所以4月7日，洛丽亲自出现在了疗养院。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 当时在整个纽约，病毒正在这些机构中迅速蔓延。

sentences.en: So on April 7th, Lori showed up at the nursing home in person.
sentences.zh: 那是全州陷入恐慌的时刻。

sentences.en: All throughout New York at this time, the virus was spreading rapidly throughout these facilities.
sentences.zh: 对于许多被告知必须接收这些病人的机构来说，他们感到非常没有准备，不知道如何处理这种情况，也不知道如何保护员工或居民。

sentences.en: It was a moment of panic across the state.
sentences.zh: 即使是之前人员充足的疗养院也开始不堪重负，许多工作人员表示他们没有适当的防护设备。

sentences.en: And for many of these places who had been told they had to accept these patients, they felt really unprepared for how to handle the situation or how to protect their staff
sentences.zh: 随着工作人员自己病倒，像洛丽这样一直试图联系他们的家属，感到与外界彻底失去了联系。

sentences.en: or residents.
sentences.zh: 这在洛丽的案例中，导致她亲自上门。

sentences.en: Even nursing homes that had been well-staffed before were starting to become overwhelmed, and many workers said they didn't have proper protective equipment.
sentences.zh: 但她在前台被一名保安拦住了。

sentences.en: As staff members themselves fell ill, family members like Lori, who had been trying to reach them, were left feeling totally cut off from information.
sentences.zh: 她说，抱歉，我不能让你进去。

sentences.en: Which, in Lori's case, led her to show up in person.
sentences.zh: 我说，不，抱歉。

sentences.en: But she was stopped by a security guard at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 我说，你最好让我进去，因为如果你不让，我就给每一家新闻台打电话，告诉他们这栋楼里有新冠病例，而且没有人通知家属。

sentences.en: She said, I'm sorry, I can't let you in.
sentences.zh: 我说，大家，我们都没见过我们的父母。

sentences.en: I said, no, I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至连和他们说话的机会都没有。

sentences.en: I said, and you better let me in because if you don't, I'm going to call every news station
sentences.zh: 这里没人接电话。

sentences.en: and tell them that there is COVID in this building and that nobody is letting families know.
sentences.zh: 这里有新冠病例，却没人告诉任何人。

sentences.en: I said, people, we have not seen our parents.
sentences.zh: 我说，我会把你们的停车场挤满。

sentences.en: We can't even get to talk to them.
sentences.zh: 于是他们让我进去了。

sentences.en: Nobody answers the phones here.
sentences.zh: 我就是这样进去的。

sentences.en: There's COVID here and nobody is telling anybody.
sentences.zh: 洛丽说，当她进去时，她被那种空荡荡和安静的感觉震惊了。

sentences.en: I said, I will fill your parking lot.
sentences.zh: 当她穿过大楼前往二楼母亲的房间时，她说她在整个侧厅只看到了几名工作人员。

sentences.en: So they let me in.
sentences.zh: 当她到达房间时，她注意到母亲床边有一盘发霉的食物。

sentences.en: That was how I got in.
sentences.zh: 她看到了她的母亲。

sentences.en: When she got inside, Lori said she was struck by how empty and how quiet it felt.
sentences.zh: 起初我以为他们把她换了房间。

sentences.en: As she made her way through the building to her mom's room on the second floor, she says she only saw a few staffers in the whole wing.
sentences.zh: 她看起来一点也不像我母亲。

sentences.en: And when she got to the room, she noticed a plate of moldy food by her mom's bedside.
sentences.zh: 一点也不。

sentences.en: And she saw her mom.
sentences.zh: 完全不像。

sentences.en: And at first I thought they moved her.
sentences.zh: 天哪，她一定瘦了30磅。

sentences.en: It looked nothing like my mother.
sentences.zh: 她整个人都脱相了。

sentences.en: Nothing.
sentences.zh: 她的脸凹陷了下去。

sentences.en: At all.
sentences.zh: 她的颧骨突了出来。

sentences.en: My God, she had to have lost 30 pounds.
sentences.zh: 她的脸颊完全凹陷进了脸部。

sentences.en: There was nothing left to her.
sentences.zh: 直到今天，我也不知道那是护士长还是医生。

sentences.en: Her face was sunken.
sentences.zh: 她人很好。

sentences.en: Her cheekbones were like protruding.
sentences.zh: 我说，我母亲快要死了。

sentences.en: And her cheeks were just hollowed out in her face.
sentences.zh: 我不明白。

sentences.en: So I don't know until this day if this was like the head nurse or a doctor.
sentences.zh: 为什么没人给我打电话？

sentences.en: And she was really nice.
sentences.zh: 她说，嗯，这不是目前的政策。

sentences.en: And I said, my mom is dying.
sentences.zh: 这会引发恐慌。

sentences.en: I don't understand.
sentences.zh: 但她没有用“恐慌”这个词。

sentences.en: How come nobody called me?
sentences.zh: 她说，你知道的，我们正试图保持冷静，我们正在尽我们所能。

sentences.en: So she said, well, it's not the policy right now.
sentences.zh: 我说，你们没有尽你们所能。

sentences.en: It would set off like a frenzy.
sentences.zh: 你们没有。

sentences.en: But she didn't use the word frenzy.
sentences.zh: 因为你们到现在还没给我母亲做新冠检测。

sentences.en: She said, you know, and we're trying to keep things calm and we're doing the best that we can.
sentences.zh: 她说，你知道，我们正努力保持冷静，我们也在尽我们所能。

sentences.en: I said, you're not doing the best you can.
sentences.zh: 我说，你们根本没有尽力。

sentences.en: You're not.
sentences.zh: 你们没有。

sentences.en: Because you still haven't tested my mother for COVID.
sentences.zh: 因为你们到现在还没给我母亲做新冠检测。

sentences.en: And my mother doesn't even have an IV in her arm.
sentences.zh: 我母亲的手臂上甚至连静脉注射管都没有。

sentences.en: What are you doing for my mother?
sentences.zh: 你们到底在为我母亲做什么？

sentences.en: She's laying in a bed dying by herself.
sentences.zh: 她独自躺在床上等死。

sentences.en: That's what she's doing.
sentences.zh: 这就是她现在的处境。

sentences.en: There's nothing here.
sentences.zh: 这里什么都没有。

sentences.en: There's nothing is being done for my mother.
sentences.zh: 没有人为我母亲做任何事。

sentences.en: So then I said to her, when, because I told my mother, you could tell she had a fever.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时对她说，因为我告诉过我母亲，你能看出她发烧了。

sentences.en: I said, when did my mother first get a fever?
sentences.zh: 我说，我母亲是什么时候开始发烧的？

sentences.en: And we walked out to the floating computer where she pulled up my mother's name and she said April 1St.
sentences.zh: 我们走到那台移动电脑前，她调出了我母亲的名字，说是一号。

sentences.en: I said, April 1st, my mother got a fever.
sentences.zh: 我说，四月一号，我母亲就开始发烧了。

sentences.en: Remember, the day before, on April 6th, Lori says the doctor on the phone had told her that her mother could not receive a COVID test because she didn't have a fever.
sentences.zh: 记住，前一天，也就是四月六号，洛丽说电话里的医生告诉她，她母亲不能接受新冠检测，因为她没有发烧。

sentences.en: I said, okay.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧。

sentences.en: And she's denied a COVID test because the doctor said she didn't have a fever.
sentences.zh: 结果她被拒绝进行新冠检测，因为医生说她没发烧。

sentences.en: And today is April 7th and she started her fever April 1St.
sentences.zh: 而今天是四月七号，她从四月一号就开始发烧了。

sentences.en: So nothing is making any sense here.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切根本说不通。

sentences.en: Lori says she left the nursing home with a promise that now they would test her mom for COVID.
sentences.zh: 洛丽说她离开疗养院时，对方承诺现在会给她母亲做新冠检测。

sentences.en: The next day, on April 8th, medical records showed that Lori's mom received her teSt.
sentences.zh: 第二天，也就是四月八号，医疗记录显示洛丽的母亲接受了检测。

sentences.en: The day after that, Lori got a call notifying her that her mom had tested positive.
sentences.zh: 再过一天，洛丽接到电话，通知她母亲检测结果呈阳性。

sentences.en: April 14th was my mother's birthday and I was making a cake.
sentences.zh: 四月十四号是我母亲的生日，我当时正在做蛋糕。

sentences.en: I'll leave it at the nurse's station and I'm going to feed my mother some cake.
sentences.zh: 我会把它留在护士站，然后去喂我母亲吃点蛋糕。

sentences.en: There's no way they're not letting me in for a birthday.
sentences.zh: 他们不可能不让我进去过生日。

sentences.en: It's not going to happen.
sentences.zh: 这绝不可能发生。

sentences.en: So I got the cake stuff ready and I wanted to put everything in the oven and that's when they called me and said, your mom passed away.
sentences.zh: 所以我准备好了做蛋糕的材料，正想把一切放进烤箱，他们就打电话来说，你母亲去世了。

sentences.en: And that was at like 9.42 in the morning or something.
sentences.zh: 那大概是早上九点四十二分左右。

sentences.en: I had just posted on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 我刚在脸书上发了动态。

sentences.en: It was three minutes before the phone call.
sentences.zh: 就在那通电话的三分钟前。

sentences.en: You know, happy birthday to mom with the whole little picture collage of her and stuff.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，祝妈妈生日快乐，还配了她的小照片拼贴画之类的。

sentences.en: But my mother was dead.
sentences.zh: 但我的母亲已经死了。

sentences.en: Her biggest fear was dying by herself.
sentences.zh: 她最大的恐惧就是独自死去。

sentences.en: That's how she spent her last day.
sentences.zh: 而她却是在这种情况下度过了最后一天。

sentences.en: There's nothing but guilt because I'm like, I was going to take her out of there.
sentences.zh: 我心里只有愧疚，因为我在想，我本该把她从那里接出来的。

sentences.en: They told me she would be safe there.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我她在那里会很安全。

sentences.en: And she died by herself, which was her biggest fear.
sentences.zh: 可她却独自一人死去了，这正是她最害怕的事。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: All day I keep so busy, so busy, so busy.
sentences.zh: 我整天让自己忙个不停，忙个不停，忙个不停。

sentences.en: When it's time to go to bed, that's all I think.
sentences.zh: 到了睡觉的时候，我满脑子想的都是这些。

sentences.en: What was she thinking when she was there all by herself?
sentences.zh: 当她独自一人在那里时，她在想什么？

sentences.en: When her biggest fear was dying by herself.
sentences.zh: 当她最大的恐惧就是独自死去的时候。

sentences.en: In the end, almost 70 people in the nursing home died of COVID.
sentences.zh: 最终，那家疗养院里有近七十人死于新冠。

sentences.en: Lori helped another woman with a family member in the facility start a Facebook group where people could communicate with one another about their experiences.
sentences.zh: 洛丽帮助另一位有亲人在该机构的女士建立了一个脸书群组，让大家可以互相交流各自的经历。

sentences.en: Many of the family members talked about taking action, possibly suing the nursing home.
sentences.zh: 许多家属谈到了要采取行动，可能会起诉这家疗养院。

sentences.en: Lori thought about going to a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 洛丽也考虑过找律师。

sentences.en: But as it turned out, a couple of weeks before Lori's mother's death, something had happened that would make taking action all but impossible.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，在洛丽母亲去世前几周，发生了一件事，使得采取行动几乎变得不可能。

sentences.en: It would be another couple weeks before the news of it would become public.
sentences.zh: 又过了几周，这个消息才公之于众。

sentences.en: But in late March, around the same time that Governor Cuomo's administration ordered that nursing homes accept COVID patients from hospitals,
sentences.zh: 但在三月下旬，大约在科莫州长政府下令疗养院接收来自医院的新冠患者的同时，

sentences.en: He quietly introduced legislation protecting nursing homes from being held accountable for most COVID deaths, including the death of Lori's mother.
sentences.zh: 他悄悄引入了立法，保护疗养院免于为大多数新冠死亡病例承担责任，包括洛丽母亲的死亡。

sentences.en: Tomorrow, in part two, the story of the Cuomo administration's decisions around nursing homes and the fallout of the last six months.
sentences.zh: 明天，在第二部分中，我们将讲述科莫政府关于疗养院的决策及其过去六个月的影响。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Monday, the Supreme Court rejected a last-ditch attempt by former President Trump to shield his financial records from prosecutors in New York.
sentences.zh: 周一，最高法院驳回了前总统特朗普试图阻止纽约检察官获取其财务记录的最后尝试。

sentences.en: The case revolves around a subpoena from the Manhattan District Attorney, Cy Vance, to Trump's accountant for tax records and financial statements since 2011.
sentences.zh: 此案围绕曼哈顿地区检察官赛·万斯向特朗普的会计师发出的传票展开，要求获取自2011年以来的税务记录和财务报表。

sentences.en: Trump has repeatedly sought to block Vance from obtaining the records.
sentences.zh: 特朗普多次试图阻止万斯获取这些记录。

sentences.en: But with Monday's ruling, the accountant now has no choice but to turn the records over.
sentences.zh: 但随着周一的裁决，会计师现在别无选择，只能交出这些记录。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 而且……

sentences.en: Today we mark a truly grim, heartbreaking milestone.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们迎来了一个真正严峻、令人心碎的里程碑。
五十万零七十一人死亡。

sentences.en: In a speech on Monday night from the White House,
sentences.zh: 在周一晚上白宫发表的演讲中，

sentences.en: President Biden marked the milestone of more than half a million deaths in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统纪念了美国因疫情死亡人数超过五十万这一里程碑。

sentences.en: from the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 从疫情开始至今。

sentences.en: I know it's hard.
sentences.zh: 我知道这很难。

sentences.en: I promise you.
sentences.zh: 我向你们保证。

sentences.en: I know it's hard.
sentences.zh: 我知道这很难。

sentences.en: I remember.
sentences.zh: 我记得。

sentences.en: But that's how you heal.
sentences.zh: 但这才是治愈的方式。

sentences.en: You have to remember.
sentences.zh: 你必须铭记。

sentences.en: Invoking his own experience with tragedy,
sentences.zh: 拜登援引自己经历悲剧的往事，

sentences.en: Biden counseled the country not to move on, but instead to honor and mourn the dead.
sentences.zh: 劝诫全国人民不要选择遗忘，而是要纪念和哀悼逝者。

sentences.en: For those who have lost loved ones,
sentences.zh: 对于那些失去亲人的人，

sentences.en: this is what I know.
sentences.zh: 这就是我所知道的。

sentences.en: They're never truly gone.
sentences.zh: 他们从未真正离去。

sentences.en: They'll always be part of your heart.
sentences.zh: 他们将永远是你内心的一部分。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Jessica Chung.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由杰西卡·钟制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Lisa Tobin, Michael Benoit, and Anita Badajo, and engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由丽莎·托宾、迈克尔·贝努瓦和安妮塔·巴达霍编辑，克里斯·伍德负责工程制作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我，莎拉·凯尼格，将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在你获取播客的地方收听。
